text:
nina (design): quick thought experiment: for the 'new-project' form should we validate onBlur (less noisy) or onChange (faster feedback)? Also what's our stance on showing requiredness in compact rows? link: figma.com/file/zzzz/new-project-form
omar (eng): onChange is nice but watch excessive network calls for uniqueness checks. debounce or do client-only checks first.
sasha (product): onboarding success suggests fewer hard stops. maybe gentle inline hints onChange, and authoritative errors on submit.
pat (a11y): accessibility: non-blocking hints should use aria-live="polite"; blocking errors need role="alert" and aria-invalid on the input. don't rely on color or placeholder for required info.
nina (design): proposal: 1) client checks onChange (polite), 2) server checks onSubmit (assertive). compact UI: use a tiny "(req)" suffix for dense lists, full "Required" for long forms.
omar (eng): implementation: expose a form flag requiredDisplay: "suffix"|"label" so we can switch without markup surgery. also avoid layout shift by reserving space for error messages.
sasha (product): delete confirmation debate: toast+undo vs typed-confirm. small deletes -> toast undo. big deletes or when downstream resources exist -> typed-confirm or checkbox.
pat (a11y): typed-confirm can be a barrier. always provide an alternative like a checkbox and ensure modal content is reachable by keyboard/screenreader.
build-bot: design-lint: contrast check passed for primary tokens; please manually verify error-red.
nina (design): action items: I'll update the Figma with the two validation timing flows and add compact suffix mock. will add copy options for errors that are action-oriented (e.g., "Try adding -1 to make it unique"). tagging you all when ready.
omar (eng): happy to pair on the requiredDisplay flag during implementation.
sasha (product): add a simple A/B plan to measure accidental delete rate and form success rate when you push mocks.
